name: deletion_impact
title: Say what deleting something would affect
description: Before a run or a document set is deleted, list what depends on it: runs that continue from the run or were trained from the set, question files in the set, and model versions, with approved ones counted. Nothing is deleted or changed; deleting stays a person's decision.

run.description: Run id or folder. Give this or set, not both.

set.description: Document set name or folder. Give this or run, not both.
